description: EF.UST marks SMS-PP data download (service 28) or RUN AT COMMAND (service 32) available (TS 31.102 clause 4.2.8)
remediation: if the operator does not use the service, clear its bit in EF.UST; for service 28 keep the card at a non-zero MSL with a TAR allow-list (run `scan --tar`), then re-scan
